component.name: DeckReader
component.summary: Controller-friendly e-book reader for Steam Deck and SteamOS

description.p: A lightweight EPUB reader designed for the SteamOS game mode, companion to Deck Video Player: browse your book folders and read entirely with the Steam Deck controls, without leaving Game Mode.
Beta software: so far it has only been tried on a Steam Deck OLED, and comes without any warranty.

ul.li: EPUB 2 and 3 with real book typography: hyphenation, justification, illustrations
Two pages side by side on the wide screen, or one page
OLED black, OLED dark, sepia and day themes, switched instantly
Literata, Inter and Atkinson Hyperlegible fonts; size, spacing and margins
Contents, bookmarks, and a left-stick scrub through the whole book
Reading position saved on every page turn, safe against sleep and power loss
Library from ~/Books, the microSD card and USB drives, with covers and recently read books
Status overlay with chapter, pages, battery and clock, and an optional progress line
Works offline: no network access, no account

description.p: The screen stays awake while a book is being read (until 10 minutes without input), and a complete About screen, also in the reading menu.
First version: local library with recently read books, reader, themes, contents, bookmarks and an optional progress line.
